claim: Since 2026-07-10, when you create a new organization in the AWS Organizations console, Organizations automatically applies SCPs that prevent member accounts from leaving the organization or closing themselves; you can modify or disable these settings at any time.
question: What security controls does AWS Organizations apply by default to a new organization created in the console, and since when?

values.display: prevent member accounts from leaving the organization
values.spoken: prevent member accounts from leaving the organization

qualifiers.scope: new organizations created in the AWS Organizations console
qualifiers.condition: available in US East (N. Virginia), AWS GovCloud (US) and China Regions

evidence.quote: When you create a new organization using the AWS Organizations console, the service automatically applies service control policies (SCPs) that prevent member accounts from leaving the organization or closing themselves.
You maintain full control to modify or disable these settings at any time.

evidence.heading: AWS Organizations now applies account departure security controls by default for new organizations created via AWS Organizations console

note: d132. GA after 2026-07-15 is not examinable yet; this one is dated 2026-07-10, so it is inside the window but very recent. Older questions assume a new organization has only FullAWSAccess attached.
